definitions.explanation: The fee charged for household or commercial gas usage. Typically billed monthly, combining a base fee and usage-based charges.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ガス{料金|りょうきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: This month's gas bill is high.

examples.japanese: ガス{料金|りょうきん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦クレジットカード→クレジットカード：06968_kurejittokaado⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{払|はら}っている→払う：00535_harau⟧。
examples.english: I pay the gas bill with a credit card.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{暖房|だんぼう}→暖房：01657_danbou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧でガス{料金|りょうきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: Gas bills go up in winter because we use the heater.

notes:
Compound of ⟦ガス→ガス：01344_gasu⟧ (gas) + ⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧ (charge; fee). One of the four standard household utility bills, along with electricity, water, and internet.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ガス{料金|りょうきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay the gas bill
- ガス{料金|りょうきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{値上|ねあ}げ→値上げ：07582_neage⟧: a rise in gas charges
- ガス{料金|りょうきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{口座振替|こうざふりかえ}→口座振替：19853_kouzafurikae⟧: automatic bank transfer for the gas bill

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{電気|でんき}{料金|りょうきん}→電気料金：26946_denkiryoukin⟧: electricity bill
- ⟦{水道|すいどう}{料金|りょうきん}→水道料金：22703_suidouryoukin⟧: water bill
- ⟦{光熱費|こうねつひ}→光熱費：08244_kounetsuhi⟧: utility costs (electricity + gas + water taken together)
